title: Groupe de Galois motivique : notes manuscrites (s.d.), lettre (1965).

deep.reconstruction: This page is essentially blank. It is the verso of a sheet, and the manuscript is rotated 180°. What shows through is mostly bleed-through of a large crossed-out or underlined heading from the other side, plus the archive page number 37. The only genuine pen marks are a few isolated symbols that look like a jotted list of the objects introduced on page 36. These are: 'G/Q' (the motivic Galois group G of the Betti fibre functor, defined over Q); 'G_K', 'P', 'G'_K' (the K-forms of the group and the torsor P with integrable absolute connection); and 'G_C/C' (the complexification, where the torsors are trivialised by α and β). In other words, the scratch lists the cast of the 'data A–G' description of a finite-type category of motives over K ⊂ C: group G over Q, torsor P under G_K, inner forms G'_K and G''_K, and comparison isomorphisms over C. There is no new mathematical content, no statement and no computation. The page sits between the list of structures and properties 1)–9) on p. 36 and the introduction of the period-map-like holomorphic map f from the universal cover of S(C) to a space of Hodge structures 𝒴_G on p. 38.

ideas.what: Scratch listing of the objects G/Q, G_K, P, G'_K, G_C/C attached to the motivic Galois group of a category of motives over K with Betti fibre functor (context from p. 36)
